Lessons.Title: End Behavior (Part 1)
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Compare and contrast (orally) the end behavior of polynomials of even and odd degree. Generalize about end behavior based on specific functions and calculations. Identify end behavior of polynomial functions from equations.

For large absolute x, the leading term dominates a polynomial. A positive even-degree leading term rises at both ends; positive odd-degree is negative on the far left and positive on the far right. The lower degree terms do not change this eventual sign pattern.
